item: Elections roster: the Wikidata national-election snapshot generator (networked operator step)
summary: One WDQS request for elections whose jurisdiction is their own country; rows in the snapshot_to_events shape with P585 precision, P580-P582 ranges and P856; primaries, caucuses, leadership contests and by-elections are left out by class label; rounds qualified P518 are one election (earliest upcoming round, all listed); no ISO code, no office, an office with no English label or conflicting dates are refused with the reason; what the query does not ask for is named in not_asked_for; full replacement that refuses to overwrite; the bundled config, AS_OF, registry and freshness test follow the first networked run.
